title: NCFBot Source Sidecar Record
description: Provenance metadata sidecar for every factual resource Markdown file in the ncfbot corpus. Each resource file must have a neighboring <name>.source.json that conforms to this schema.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier unique across the entire corpus. Never reuse or rename after other sidecars reference it.

resource_file.description: Repo-relative path to the paired Markdown resource file, e.g. resources/students/academic-model.md

title.description: Human-readable resource title matching the Markdown file's top-level heading.

audiences.description: Which audiences this resource primarily serves. Resources under resources/shared/ serve multiple audiences; list all that apply.

topics.description: Short topic slugs used by the retrieval layer to filter resources, e.g. ['registration', 'add-drop'].

sources.description: Every public source consulted when authoring or updating this resource.

canonical_url.description: Canonical HTTPS URL of the public source page or document.

publisher.description: Office, catalog, or body responsible for this source, e.g. 'NCF Registrar' or 'Undergraduate Catalog 2024-2025'.

authority_type.description: Category of source authority. Determines default trust rank when sources conflict.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this URL was independently fetched and verified, e.g. 2026-08-31T14:00:00Z. Pattern enforces UTC-only (Z suffix) so validation works without optional format-checker packages.

last_modified.description: HTTP Last-Modified value if returned by the server, else null.

effective_from.description: Date or term from which the source content is effective, e.g. '2024-08-26' or 'Fall 2024'. Null if unknown.

effective_through.description: Date or term through which the source content is effective. Null if ongoing or unknown.

academic_year.description: Applicable academic year in YYYY-YYYY format, e.g. '2024-2025', or null if not applicable.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the retrieved source body. Required non-null string; run fetch_sources.py before running validate_sources.py.

public_access_verified.description: True only if a human confirmed the URL is reachable without authentication or credentials. Never set true based on assumption.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this resource. 'current' = actively maintained and applicable. 'historical' = describes a past period only. 'superseded' = replaced by a newer resource; retain for provenance.

volatility.description: How quickly the underlying facts are expected to change. Drives review_after scheduling and freshness warnings.

review_after.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which this resource should be re-verified. check_freshness.py flags overdue records.

notes.description: Known conflicts, coverage gaps, ambiguities, or empty string if none. Required field; do not omit even if empty.

required_resources.description: Optional. Resources that must be loaded before this one can support a class of answer. Each entry names the required resource and explains why. Existing sidecars without this field remain valid.

resource_id.description: Stable kebab-case ID of the resource that must be present.

reason.description: Why this resource depends on the named one, e.g. 'provides the catalog-year context required to interpret deadlines'.

conflicts.description: Optional. Known conflicts between two or more public sources on a claim covered by this resource. Structured so Agent 7 can surface unresolved conflicts without parsing prose. Existing sidecars without this field remain valid.

conflict_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this conflict record.

status.description: 'unresolved' = no authoritative ruling yet; 'resolved' = owning office confirmed; 'deferred' = known but not blocking Version 1.

sources.description: Two or more public source URLs making incompatible claims.

claims.description: One short quoted or paraphrased claim per source, in the same order as 'sources'.

applicability.description: Scope where the conflict applies, e.g. 'Fall 2026 add/drop deadline for undergraduate students'.

responsible_office.description: Office that can issue an authoritative ruling, e.g. 'NCF Registrar'.
